title: Documentation Governance Umsetzung
goal: Implement the approved documentation governance model by establishing a durable policy, separating end-user/admin/maintainer documentation, auditing existing mixed content, aligning the help PDF pipeline, and preparing a documentation quality gate.
constraints: Do not contradict or override root AGENTS.md, .agents/**, skills, workflows, or other OMA development instructions.
Do not modify .agents/** unless a later implementation task explicitly requires changing the agent system itself.
Serena Memory remains working context, not durable repo documentation SSOT.
End-user docs under docs/pros-hilfe-src/** must stay task-oriented and free of internal OMA/repo-development details.
No frontend/backend or service API contract is introduced by this plan.

apiContract.decision: No API contract artifact is required because the scope affects documentation governance, generated help artifacts, and repository validation rather than service interfaces.

tasks.title: Dokumentationsinventar und Audit-Matrix erstellen
acceptanceCriteria: All relevant files and notable Memory groups from Design 009 are inventoried.
Each item has audience, lifetime, authority, current issue, target action, and migration status.

tasks.title: docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md als dauerhafte Richtlinie erstellen
acceptanceCriteria: The governance document contains documentation spaces, placement rules, OMA development precedence, Memory rules, end-user/admin-support separation, and a review checklist.
The document is concise enough for daily maintainer use and links back to Design 009 for full rationale.

tasks.title: Leichte Querverweise in Architektur-, Plan- und Design-Index-Doku ergänzen
acceptanceCriteria: ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PLANS.md, and docs/design-docs/index.md point to the governance document without duplicating it.
Existing repo/runtime boundary rules remain consistent.

tasks.title: docs/admin-support/** Zielstruktur einführen
acceptanceCriteria: An admin/support documentation home exists with an index and scope statement.
The scope clearly separates admin/support setup and troubleshooting from end-user help.

tasks.title: README zu Einstieg und Index zurückschneiden
acceptanceCriteria: README links to developer, end-user, and admin/support locations instead of duplicating full manuals.
README remains useful as the repository entry point.

tasks.title: Endnutzerhandbuch bereinigen
acceptanceCriteria: docs/pros-hilfe-src/endnutzerhandbuch.md contains only end-user tasks, safety rules, and simple escalation guidance.
Technical setup, MCP, credential, and deep troubleshooting details are moved or linked through admin/support documentation.

tasks.title: Skill-Katalog neu entscheiden und bereinigen
acceptanceCriteria: Internal oma-*, workflow, and maintainer skill names are no longer shipped as end-user help.
The help PDF pipeline remains consistent if skill-katalog is removed, renamed, or replaced with curated product capabilities.

tasks.title: Technische MCP-/Credential-/CLI-Inhalte in Admin/Support-Doku konsolidieren
acceptanceCriteria: docs/CLI-MCP-COMMANDS.md, docs/MCP-CREDENTIALS.md, and end-user help have clear target audiences.
Credential and integration rules do not contradict runtime manifest or security guidance.

tasks.title: PDF-Hilfe-Pipeline an neue Endnutzer-Doku anpassen
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/generate-pros-hilfe.py --list reflects only approved end-user help documents.
Generated runtime PDFs match the cleaned docs/pros-hilfe-src sources.

tasks.title: Dokumentations-Governance-Checkliste als manuelles Gate dokumentieren
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist covers audience, SSOT, end-user purity, secrets/PII, runtime boundary, and duplication checks.
Checklist is usable without blocking OMA workflow execution.

tasks.title: Optionales automatisierbares Gate konzipieren oder minimal implementieren
acceptanceCriteria: Either a clear follow-up plan/tech-debt entry exists, or a small validator is implemented without breaking OMA workflows.
Any automation starts advisory unless it detects hard risks such as secrets or internal details in end-user docs.

tasks.title: Release-/Runtime-Verifikation ausführen und dokumentieren
acceptanceCriteria: PDF generation, runtime file validation, and relevant tests/checks are run or blockers are documented.
Verification confirms cleaned end-user docs are reflected in runtime help artifacts.

tasks.title: Abschlussreview gegen Design 009
acceptanceCriteria: All Design 009 acceptance criteria are reviewed.
Any deviations are recorded in the decision log or tech debt tracker.

doneWhen: docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md is the clear SSOT for documentation placement.
End-user help contains no internal OMA or repo-development details.
Admin/support documentation has a dedicated home.
README is an entry point and index, not a mixed full manual.
Runtime help PDFs are generated from cleaned sources.
Technical docs have clear target audiences and no unresolved contradictions.
Serena Memory remains working context, not durable primary documentation.
OMA development instructions remain untouched and authoritative.
Verification results or blockers are documented.

decisionLog.rationale: The work spans multiple documentation spaces, runtime help generation, existing plan coordination, migration, and a future documentation check-gate.

decisionLog.decision: No API contract artifact is required.
decisionLog.rationale: The plan does not introduce frontend/backend or service-to-service APIs.

decisionLog.decision: Proceed with root-cause governance and migration rather than a tactical README-only cleanup.
decisionLog.rationale: Design 009 identified missing content governance as the underlying cause of documentation drift and audience mixing.
